This nectar is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in north-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

Bluedrake nectar is poured over a burn and left against the skin for six hours. Its numbing effect eases pain while promoting the healing of the tissues. It remains potent for as long as nine months, allowing healers to maintain a reserve despite the plant's exceptional rarity.
